func ArchUnitRule(c TestCase) (ArchitectureRule, bool)

type ArchitectureReport struct {
	Rules []ArchitectureRule `json:"rules"`
}

type ArchitectureRule struct {
	Name       string      `json:"name"`
	Status     string      `json:"status"`
	Count      int         `json:"count"`
	Violations []Violation `json:"violations,omitempty"`
}

const CodeMalformed = "readers.malformed"

const CodeMissing = "readers.missing"

const CodeTooLarge = "readers.too_large"

const CodeUnreadable = "readers.unreadable"

type Counts struct {
	Total   int `json:"total"`
	Covered int `json:"covered"`
}

type CoverageReport struct {
	Sources []string       `json:"sources,omitempty"`
	Files   []FileCoverage `json:"files"`
}

func CycloneDXVersions() []string

type Failure struct {
	Error   bool   `json:"error,omitempty"`
	Type    string `json:"type,omitempty"`
	Message string `json:"message,omitempty"`
	Body    string `json:"body,omitempty"`
}

type FileCoverage struct {
	Path       string `json:"path"`
	Lines      []Line `json:"lines,omitempty"`
	LineCounts Counts `json:"lineCounts"`
	Functions  Counts `json:"functions"`
}

const FormatCycloneDX = "cyclonedx"

const FormatSPDX = "spdx"

type Line struct {
	Number int   `json:"number"`
	Hits   int64 `json:"hits"`
}

const MaxLineMarks = 4_000_000

const MaxReportBytes = 256 << 20

const MaxSuiteDepth = 100

func MoreSevere(a, b string) bool

type PURL struct {
	Type    string
	Name    string
	Version string
}

type Package struct {
	Name            string          `json:"name"`
	Version         string          `json:"version,omitempty"`
	PURL            string          `json:"purl,omitempty"`
	Licenses        []string        `json:"licenses,omitempty"`
	Vulnerabilities []Vulnerability `json:"vulnerabilities,omitempty"`
}

func ParsePURL(raw string) (PURL, error)

func ReadClover(data []byte) (CoverageReport, []diag.Diagnostic)

func ReadCobertura(data []byte) (CoverageReport, []diag.Diagnostic)

func ReadDeptrac(data []byte) (ArchitectureReport, []diag.Diagnostic)

func ReadFile[T any](path string, read func([]byte) (T, []diag.Diagnostic)) (T, []diag.Diagnostic)

func ReadGoCover(data []byte) (CoverageReport, []diag.Diagnostic)

func ReadImportLinter(data []byte) (ArchitectureReport, []diag.Diagnostic)

func ReadJUnit(data []byte) (TestReport, []diag.Diagnostic)

func ReadJaCoCo(data []byte) (CoverageReport, []diag.Diagnostic)

func ReadLCOV(data []byte) (CoverageReport, []diag.Diagnostic)

func ReadSBOM(data []byte) (SBOM, []diag.Diagnostic)

func ReadTRX(data []byte) (TestReport, []diag.Diagnostic)

const RuleBroken = "broken"

const RuleKept = "kept"

type SBOM struct {
	Format      string    `json:"format"`
	SpecVersion string    `json:"specVersion"`
	Packages    []Package `json:"packages"`
}

func SPDXVersions() []string

func Severities() []string

const SeverityCritical = "critical"

const SeverityHigh = "high"

const SeverityInfo = "info"

const SeverityLow = "low"

const SeverityMedium = "medium"

const SeverityNone = "none"

const SeverityUnknown = "unknown"

type Skipped struct {
	Message string `json:"message,omitempty"`
	Body    string `json:"body,omitempty"`
}

const StatusFailed = "failed"

const StatusPassed = "passed"

const StatusSkipped = "skipped"

type Suite struct {
	Name string `json:"name,omitempty"`
	File string `json:"file,omitempty"`
}

type TestCase struct {
	Name       string   `json:"name"`
	Classname  string   `json:"classname,omitempty"`
	Suites     []Suite  `json:"suites,omitempty"`
	File       string   `json:"file,omitempty"`
	Line       int      `json:"line,omitempty"`
	Status     string   `json:"status"`
	DurationMs int64    `json:"durationMs"`
	Failure    *Failure `json:"failure,omitempty"`
	Skipped    *Skipped `json:"skipped,omitempty"`
}

type TestReport struct {
	Totals Totals     `json:"totals"`
	Cases  []TestCase `json:"cases"`
}

type Totals struct {
	Tests      int     `json:"tests"`
	Failures   int     `json:"failures"`
	Errors     int     `json:"errors"`
	Skipped    int     `json:"skipped"`
	Assertions int     `json:"assertions"`
	Time       float64 `json:"time"`
}

func UsesArchUnit(source []byte) bool

type Violation struct {
	Message string `json:"message"`
	Subject string `json:"subject,omitempty"`
	File    string `json:"file,omitempty"`
	Line    int    `json:"line,omitempty"`
}

type Vulnerability struct {
	ID       string `json:"id"`
	Severity string `json:"severity"`
}
